in_sanskrit.name: आम्ला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Amla in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit word अम्ला (amla), which means 'sour', 'tart', or 'sharp'. This name is commonly used in Hindu mythology and is associated with the goddess Amla Devi, who represents the power of sour or tart flavors and is believed to bestow health, longevity, and purification.
